name: sg-llm-model-picker
description: Compact model selector dropdown for any LLM provider with live refresh

attributes.provider: Provider id: openrouter | ollama | anthropic | openai
attributes.base-url: Optional base URL override (for custom Ollama endpoints)

emits.llm:model-changed: { model: string } — when user selects a model (dispatched on parentElement)

consumes.llm:connected: { provider, model, baseUrl, apiKey } — auto-loads models and pre-selects model

api.setProvider: async (provider, apiKey, baseUrl) => void — load models for a provider
